data.name: Jannahun
data.gender_notes: Jannahun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that symbolizes the beauty and tranquility of the Gardens of Paradise, a place of eternal happiness and joy. The name Jannahun carries the meaning “Garden of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jannahun usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the eternal garden of paradise, a place of peace and serenity, where one can find closeness to Allah and experience true happiness and joy.
data.etymology: Jannahun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jannahun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: جنة
in_arabic.meaning: الجنة هي اسم مؤنث معناه الجنة أو الفردوس
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجنة هي اسم مؤنث مشتق من الجنة، وتعني الفردوس أو الجنة. الجنة في الإسلام هي المكان الذي يعد الله تعالى أعدائه يوم القيامة، وهي المقابل للعذاب. اسم الجنة هو اسم جميل يوحي بالراحة والسلام.

in_urdu.name: جنت
in_urdu.meaning: جنت ایک خوبصورت نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے جنت یا فردوس
in_urdu.long_meaning: جنت ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے جنة سے ماخوذ ہے۔ جنة کا مطلب ہے جنت یا فردوس۔ اسلامی روایت میں جنت ایک ایسا مقام ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ نے اپنے عباد کے لئے تیار کیا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जन्नत
in_hindi.meaning: जन्नत एक सुंदर नाम है जिसका अर्थ है स्वर्ग या फिर्दौस
in_hindi.long_meaning: जन्नत एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के जन्नत से लिया गया है। जन्नत का अर्थ है स्वर्ग या फिर्दौस। इस्लामी परंपरा में जन्नत एक ऐसा स्थान है जो अल्लाह ने अपने सेवकों के लिए तैयार किया है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है।

in_pashto.name: جنت
in_pashto.meaning: جنت دى يو ښکلى نوم دى چه معنا يې جنت يا فردوس دى
in_pashto.long_meaning: جنت دى يو مؤنث نوم دى چه د عربي ژبې د جنة څخه اخستل شوى دى. جنة د مطلب جنت يا فردوس دى. په اسلامي دود کې جنت داسې ځاى دى چه الله تعالى د خپلو بندګو لپاره چمتو کړى دى. دا نوم د افغانانو او پښتنو په منځ کې ډير مشهور دى.

in_english.name: Jannahun
in_english.long_meaning: Jannahun is a feminine name derived from the Arabic word 'Jannah', meaning paradise or heavenly abode. In Islamic tradition, Jannah refers to the garden or haven created by Allah for the righteous. The name symbolizes peace, serenity, and bliss. It is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the aspiration for a peaceful and divine life.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Jannahun" holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as it is derived from the Arabic word "Jannat" which means gardens. Gardens are a common theme in Islamic art, architecture, and literature. The name "Jannahun" evokes the concept of paradise, a place of ultimate beauty, peace, and pleasure where Muslims believe they will go after death.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Jannahun" is deeply significant as it represents the desire for eternal happiness and closeness to God. In Islamic tradition, Jannah, or paradise, is described as a lush garden filled with rivers, fruits, and beautiful maidens. The name "Jannahun" can serve as a reminder of the rewards of living a virtuous life and following Islamic teachings. It can also be a source of comfort and hope for Muslims, who believe that their faith and good works will ensure their entry into paradise.
